summary: Phase 1 Player Interface is complete and correct. All 3 plan tasks (Red, Green, Refactor) are marked [x] with matching commit SHAs. The Player interface (6 methods) is defined in player.go, aligned with PlaybackPipeline's shape (SeekTo/QueryPosition/QueryDuration). fakePlayer in player_fake.go is fully scriptable with position tracking, duration, state machine, error injection. 12 contract tests + 1 smoke test all pass. Compile-time assertions pin both fakePlayer and PlaybackPipeline to the Player interface. Full media package (98 tests) and make check (18 packages) are green. go vet clean. No stubs, no shallow tests, no intentionally-red tests in aggregate suites, no fake-harness masking. One non-blocking observation: fakePlayer is unexported, so Phases 4/5 will need to export it or create package-local fakes for cross-package reuse.
